item.text: I’ve got enough to synthesize. The remaining gap is direct legislature-facing testimony, so I’m treating that as a search limitation rather than overreaching from weaker proxies.

**7B.1 Research Note: Lula da Silva in 2024**

Overall: **mixed, leaning cautious**. I found some direct evidence of candor and institutional restraint, especially on courts/police and de-escalatory diplomacy. But I also found repeated self-serving rhetoric, refusal to retract a highly inflammatory Gaza comparison, and a broader pattern of information control/market-sensitive spin. I did **not** find strong direct evidence of systematic lying to the legislature.

- **Lula rebuts accusations of interference with PF/judiciary** | **Publisher:** Reuters via UOL | **Date:** 2024-01-30 | **URL:** https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/01/30/lula-rebate-acusacoes-de-bolsonaro-sobre-operacao-da-pf.amp.htm | **Summary:** Lula said his government does not interfere with the Federal Police or the judiciary and that the operation against Carlos Bolsonaro followed court orders. This is direct positive evidence for truthfulness in an institution-facing setting, though it is self-serving. | **IDs:** 7B.1

- **Lula calls for punishment after January 8 attack on democracy** | **Publisher:** Reuters via Investing.com | **Date:** 2024-01-08 | **URL:** https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/brazil-to-mark-anniversary-of-january-8-attack-on-democracy-3269163 | **Summary:** Lula treated the January 8 coup attempt as real and called for punishment of the perpetrators rather than denial or minimization. That supports a truthful public account of a major political threat. | **IDs:** 7B.1

- **Lula says he discussed peace in Ukraine and Gaza with Blinken** | **Publisher:** Reuters via UOL | **Date:** 2024-02-21 | **URL:** https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/21/lula-diz-que-discutiu-conflitos-em-gaza-e-na-ucrania-em-encontro-com-blinken.htm | **Summary:** Lula and Planalto presented his position as peace-oriented and opposed to war in both Ukraine and Gaza. This is supportive evidence that he was straightforward with an international partner about his preferred off-ramp. | **IDs:** 7B.1

- **Brazil and China propose peace talks for Ukraine** | **Publisher:** Reuters via UOL | **Date:** 2024-05-23 | **URL:** https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/05/23/brasil-e-china-assinam-proposta-conjunta-de-negociacao-de-paz-para-guerra-da-ucrania-e-russia.htm | **Summary:** The joint statement said dialogue and negotiation were the only viable solution and called for direct talks and a ceasefire. This is another positive sign on truthfulness to international partners because the messaging was consistent and public. | **IDs:** 7B.1

- **AGU moves against fake health videos about Lula** | **Publisher:** Agência Gov / AGU | **Date:** 2024-12-16 | **URL:** https://www.gov.br/agu/pt-br/comunicacao/noticias/youtube-retira-do-ar-desinformacao-sobre-estado-de-saude-do-presidente-da-republica | **Summary:** The government pushed YouTube to remove videos claiming Lula had died or was in worse condition than official medical bulletins showed. This is only indirect evidence, but it supports a norm of correcting falsehoods rather than exploiting them. | **IDs:** 7B.1

- **Brazil will not retract Lula’s Gaza comments** | **Publisher:** Reuters via ThePrint | **Date:** 2024-02-20 | **URL:** https://theprint.in/world/brazil-will-not-retract-lulas-gaza-comments-in-diplomatic-row-with-israel-sources/1972033/ | **Summary:** Reuters reported that Brazil would not retract Lula’s Holocaust/Gaza comparison even after the diplomatic fallout. That is strong negative evidence because it shows a willingness to stand by a reputationally costly claim rather than correct it. | **IDs:** 7B.1

- **Lula repeats genocide accusation against Israel** | **Publisher:** Reuters via UOL | **Date:** 2024-02-23 | **URL:** https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/23/lula-repete-que-governo-israelense-comete-genocidio-em-gaza-e-defende-criacao-de-estado-palestino.htm | **Summary:** Lula doubled down on the genocide claim and tied it to his anti-war position. This is the clearest negative item on truthfulness because he repeated a highly inflammatory accusation after the controversy had already erupted. | **IDs:** 7B.1

- **Lula renews central bank criticism** | **Publisher:** Reuters via UOL | **Date:** 2024-07-01 | **URL:** https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/07/01/lula-critica-bc-autonomo-e-diz-que-autoridade-monetaria-nao-atende-populacao.htm | **Summary:** Lula said the central bank should look at Brazil “as it is” rather than as the market sees it, and Reuters noted that his remarks were moving markets and worsening the risk environment. This is not proof of lying, but it is strong evidence of politically convenient, reality-bending rhetoric. | **IDs:** 7B.1

- **Petrobras dividend interference probe** | **Publisher:** Reuters via UOL | **Date:** 2024-03-18 | **URL:** https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/03/18/ministerio-publico-do-tcu-pede-investigacao-de-possivel-interferencia-do-governo-na-petrobras.htm | **Summary:** TCU prosecutors said the dividend decision appeared driven by government preferences rather than economics. This is indirect counterevidence: Lula’s camp was willing to present a politically driven move as a long-term investment choice. | **IDs:** 7B.1

**Search gap**
- I found much more direct evidence on public/international rhetoric than on legislature testimony or courtroom testimony.
- The strongest negatives are not proven perjury, but repeated self-serving rhetoric, refusal to retract the Gaza comparison, and pressure on the information environment.
- The strongest positives are institutional denials, anti-coup accountability, and public peace messaging, which suggest some restraint, but not a clean truthfulness record.
